title: daphne pampaninii subsp. subcyclolepidota
intro: Daphne pampaninii subsp. subcyclolepidota, commonly known as Himalayan daphne, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the genus Daphne. It is primarily known for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Himalayan daphne include daphnetin, daphnoretin, and daphniphylline, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-cancer, and antiviral properties. The health benefits of Himalayan daphne include reducing inflammation, fighting against infections, and protecting against cell damage, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
